plan.title: Alan Turing: The Man Who Taught Machines to Think
plan.description: A quick look at Alan Turing, the British mathematician who helped break a wartime code and asked whether machines can think. Learn why his ideas still shape every computer today.

beats.narration: One man helped end a war, then imagined the computer age. His name was Alan Turing, and most people have never heard his story.

props.text: He helped end a war, then invented the future.

beats.narration: Turing was a brilliant British mathematician. In World War Two, he helped crack the secret Enigma code, giving the Allies a powerful advantage.
He also asked a bold question: can machines think? His idea of a universal computing machine is the blueprint for every computer we use today.
Yet he was treated cruelly by the country he served. Today, every phone in your pocket carries his legacy. Remember his name.
